title: The Limits of Query Monitoring against Distributed Model Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2610.13083v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Model providers now face distillation campaigns run through thousands of accounts, each of which looks like an ordinary user. When network and payment metadata cannot link those accounts, the only evidence left is what they ask. We study what a provider can and cannot learn from those queries alone, using one million real chat turns for development and 17 later weeks that no design choice touched for a single frozen evaluation. The answer is set less by anything specific to extraction than by benign coordination: a campaign is visible only if it is more distinctive than the most distinctive group of ordinary users in the same week. We make this precise, show that a small but positive difference between campaign and users buys a detection time rather than detectability, and identify the campaign that is hardest to detect. Empirically, a calibrated monitor catches naive distributed extraction that per-account monitors miss (0.86-1.00 of

translated_title: 针对分布式模型提取的查询监控的局限性
translated_abstract: 模型提供商如今面临着通过数千个账户开展的蒸馏攻击活动，其中每个账户看起来都像是一名普通用户。当网络与支付元数据无法将这些账户关联起来时，剩下的唯一证据就是它们的查询内容。我们研究了提供商仅凭这些查询能够获知什么、不能获知什么：我们使用一百万条真实对话轮次进行方法开发，并采用之后17周内任何设计决策都未曾接触过的数据进行单次冻结评估。研究结论表明，检测结果更多取决于良性的用户协同行为，而非提取活动本身的特殊性：只有当提取活动比同一周内最独特的普通用户群体更为独特时，它才是可被发现的。我们对这一结论给出了精确刻画，证明提取活动与普通用户之间微小但为正的差异所带来的是检测时间而非可检测性的提升，并识别出了最难检测的提取活动。在实证方面，经过校准的监控器能够捕获逐账户监控器所遗漏的朴素分布式提取（0.86-1.00 ...
tldr: 该研究基于百万条真实对话数据表明，仅凭查询监控检测分布式模型提取的能力从根本上受普通用户协同行为所限，只有当提取活动比同一周内最独特的正常用户群体更加独特时才能被发现。
en_tdlr: The detectability of distributed model extraction via query monitoring is fundamentally bounded by benign user coordination: a campaign is visible only if it is more distinctive than the most distinctive group of ordinary users in the same week.
